rule_based.description: A strategy assembled from rules in the builder: a market filter, exit and entry conditions, selection, weights and risk limits.
rule_based.indicator.price.label: Price
rule_based.indicator.price.hint: The last closing price of the series, dividends included.
rule_based.indicator.sma.label: Simple moving average (SMA)
rule_based.indicator.sma.hint: The average price over the last N trading days.
rule_based.indicator.ema.label: Exponential moving average (EMA)
rule_based.indicator.ema.hint: The average price over N days where recent days weigh more.
rule_based.indicator.priceVsSma.label: Price vs SMA
rule_based.indicator.priceVsSma.hint: How far the price is above (plus) or below (minus) its moving average.
rule_based.indicator.priceVsSma.phrase: distance of the price of {of} to its {days}-day SMA
rule_based.indicator.momentum.label: Momentum
rule_based.indicator.momentum.hint: The return over the last N months (21 trading days a month).
rule_based.indicator.blendedMomentum.hin: The average of the 3, 6 and 12-month returns, as in adaptive momentum.
rule_based.indicator.relativeStrength.hi: The series' return minus the benchmark's return over the same N months.
rule_based.indicator.volatility.label: Volatility
rule_based.indicator.volatility.hint: The yearly volatility of daily returns over the last N days.
rule_based.indicator.drawdown.label: Drawdown from peak
rule_based.indicator.drawdown.hint: How far the price is below its high over the last N days.
rule_based.indicator.sharpe.label: Sharpe
rule_based.indicator.sharpe.hint: The yearly return divided by the yearly volatility over N months, without a risk-free rate.
rule_based.indicator.rsi.label: RSI
rule_based.indicator.rsi.hint: Wilder's relative strength index over N days, from 0 to 100.
rule_based.condition.compare.label: Comparison
rule_based.condition.compare.hint: Compares an indicator with a number or with another indicator.
rule_based.condition.between.label: Within range
rule_based.condition.between.hint: The indicator's value lies between two numbers.
rule_based.condition.crossed.label: Crossing
rule_based.condition.crossed.hint: The indicator crossed a level or another indicator within the last N trading days.
rule_based.condition.signal.label: My signal
rule_based.condition.signal.hint: Whether your market signal is active right now.
rule_based.condition.all.label: All conditions (AND)
rule_based.condition.all.hint: Holds when every nested condition holds.
rule_based.condition.any.label: Any condition (OR)
rule_based.condition.any.hint: Holds when at least one nested condition holds.
rule_based.condition.not.label: Not (NOT)
rule_based.condition.not.hint: Holds when the nested condition does not hold.
rule_based.field.scope: For what (required): “for any instrument” is one signal for the whole market, “for this fund” checks the signal for each fund separately
rule_based.field.investWhenUnfavorable: What share to keep in funds when the market is unfavourable; the mode decides how
rule_based.field.whenUnfavorable: What to do with held funds when the market is unfavourable
rule_based.field.maxCorrelation: Highest correlation with a fund already chosen
rule_based.field.correlationDays: Over how many days to measure correlation
rule_based.field.volatilityDays: Over how many days to measure a fund's volatility
rule_based.field.targetVolatilityDays: Over how many days to measure the portfolio's volatility
rule_based.field.stopLossFromCost: Sell at a loss from cost of
rule_based.field.drawdownFromPeak: Sell at a drawdown from peak of
rule_based.check.fund_in_market_filter: Indicator “{name}” measures the current fund, but the market filter looks only at the market
rule_based.check.this_fund_signal_in_mar: A “for this fund” signal cannot be used in the market filter
rule_based.check.crossed_needs_one_side: A crossing needs either a level or another indicator, but not both
rule_based.check.extra_needs_instrument: Indicator “{name}” measures another instrument: choose which one
rule_based.check.instrument_without_extr: Indicator “{name}” does not measure another instrument, so an instrument is not needed for it
rule_based.check.rank_by_unknown: There is no indicator “{name}” to rank by
rule_based.reason.short_history: {name}: too little history, {days} trading days needed
rule_based.fund.failed: did not meet the entry condition: {items:join:; }
rule_based.fund.stronger_exist: place {rank}: stronger funds already took every slot
rule_based.report.rebalance.name: Rebalance
rule_based.report.rebalance.description: Checks the market filter, the exit and entry rules, chooses the funds and says what to buy and sell.
rule_based.report.risk-review.name: Risk review
rule_based.report.risk-review.descriptio: Sells positions where the stop from cost, the drawdown from peak or an exit rule fired.
rule_based.rationale.title: Why these funds
rule_based.summary.nothing: No fund passed the rules, the money waits in the cash fund.
rule_based.summary.picked: Chosen {count}: {names:join:, }. The funds hold {share:percent} of their share.
rule_based.market.no_filter: There is no market filter: the funds get their full share.
rule_based.market.unfavorable: The market is unfavourable ({items:join:; }): the funds hold only {share:percent}, the rest is in the cash fund.
rule_based.market.unfavorable_new_money: The market is unfavourable ({items:join:; }): held funds stay, {share:percent} of new contributions goes to the funds, the rest waits in the cash fund.
rule_based.market.nothing_qualified: No fund passed the rules: the money waits in the cash fund.
rule_based.market.exposure_reduced: The chosen funds swing {volatility:percent} a year, above the target of {target:percent}: the funds hold only {share:percent} of their share.
rule_based.error.no_price: Fund {instrument} has no price before {asOf}, so it cannot be judged.
rule_based.error.stale_price: On {asOf} the last price of fund {instrument} is from {lastPriceOn}, but judging it needs a price no older than {maxDays} days.
rule_based.risk.stop_loss: the loss of {loss:signedPercent} from cost reached the limit of {limit:signedPercent}
rule_based.risk.drawdown: the drawdown of {drawdown:signedPercent} from the peak reached the limit of {limit:signedPercent}
rule_based.check.range_reversed: The lower bound of a range cannot exceed the upper one
rule_based.fund.correlation_unknown: Cannot check the correlation with {peer}: not enough shared data or no price variation
